notes.title: BackStreet Update Notes (July 15, 2025)
notes.content: [h1]⚡ BackStreet Update Notes (July 15, 2025)[/h1][p]This demo update brings improvements to combat visuals, stage flow, control usability, and adds a new menu introducing information about the full version.[/p][p][/p][h2]🎮 Combat & Targeting Improvements  [/h2][p]- Action Launch condition relaxed: Previously triggered only when enemies were over 200 units away, now activates at 50 units or more  [/p][p]- Targeting range for bosses increased: Lock-on is now maintained at nearly double the previous range[/p][p][/p][h2]🛠 Bug Fixes  [/h2][p]- Fixed an issue where training dummies floated or failed to disappear[/p][p][/p][h2]📘 Combat & Chapter Structure Adjustments  [/h2][p]- One additional early-stage combat section has been added to improve pacing  [/p][p]- The cost of the following skills has increased by 5: Multi Slash, Linear Slash, Weak Point Analysis, and Hell Purge[/p][p][/p][h2]⚖ Balance Adjustments  [/h2][p]- Healing item prices reduced by 10 to ease resource management[/p][p][/p][h2]🖥 UI & UX Improvements  [/h2][p]- Changed prompt when declining rewards: “Continue” → “Discard”  [/p][p]- The lock-on button for gamepads has been unified with the camera reset function and changed to the right analog stick (R3).[/p][p][/p][h2]📌 New Menu: About the Full Version  [/h2][p]- A new “About the Full Version” menu has been added to the main screen  [/p][p]- Includes upcoming features and systems with images and localization support[/p][p][/p]

tags.balance_change: - Action Launch condition relaxed: Previously triggered only when enemies were over 200 units away, now activates at 50 units or more
- Targeting range for bosses increased: Lock-on is now maintained at nearly double the previous range

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where training dummies floated or failed to disappear

tags.feature: - One additional early-stage combat section has been added to improve pacing

tags.balance_change: - The cost of the following skills has increased by 5: Multi Slash, Linear Slash, Weak Point Analysis, and Hell Purge
- Healing item prices reduced by 10 to ease resource management
- Changed prompt when declining rewards: “Continue” → “Discard”
- The lock-on button for gamepads has been unified with the camera reset function and changed to the right analog stick (R3).

- Includes upcoming features and systems with images and localization support

notes.title: BackStreet Update Notes (v0.2.0, July 14, 2025)
notes.content: [h1]⚡ BackStreet Update Notes (v0.2.0, July 14, 2025)[/h1][p]This update focuses on improving combat feedback, refining the targeting system, and enhancing tutorials and guidance. Control responsiveness and visual feedback have been significantly improved, along with a more polished UI and combat presentation.[/p][p][/p][h2]🎮 Combat System & Feedback Improvements[/h2][p]- Hard targeting reintroduced: target lock-on and dedicated camera angle applied[/p][p]- Soft targeting reworked: directional input-based targeting and priority logic improved[/p][p]- Camera reset function added (excluding Pitch)[/p][p]- Knockback logic improvements:[/p][p]　　- Combo knockback reduced (5x → 3.5x)[/p][p]　　- Max distance limited to 200[/p][p]　　- Knockback resistance added based on defense stat[/p][p]- Hitstop enhanced and now differentiates normal vs. critical attacks[/p][p]- Action launch direction corrected and range limit removed[/p][p]- Mid-air jittering during attacks resolved, collision handling optimized[/p][p]- Default key input changes:[/p][p]　　- Keyboard: Dodge (LShift → LAlt)[/p][p]　　- Controller: Fire (LT → merged with attack key)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]📘 Tutorial & Guidance Enhancements[/h2][p]- Added tutorial dummies and new key-specific missions[/p][p]- Key guide integrated into tutorial UI[/p][p]- Gamepad and key binding options reflected in guides[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🖥 UI & UX Improvements[/h2][p]- Improved visibility of information panels (blurred dark background applied)[/p][p]- Removed keyguide display from material crafting UI[/p][p]- Skill cooldown now highlighted[/p][p]- Fixed focus issues in PauseMenu / WeaponSelect[/p][p]- Localized naming of skills and items improved[/p][p]- Tutorials restructured to be image-driven[/p][p]- Overall map brightness adjusted[/p][p]　　- Default gamma changed to 3.0[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🛠 System Improvements & Fixes[/h2][p]- Stage length reduced:[/p][p]　　- 5 combat stages, 2 crafting stages[/p][p]- Added portal / gate indicators[/p][p]- Added directional skill indicators for enemies[/p][p]- Improved sub-weapon swapping: swap with current one instead of replacing[/p][p]- Removed pillar interaction in boss maps[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]+) This translation was generated by AI and may contain unnatural phrasing.[/p]

- Max distance limited to 200

notes.title: BackStreet Demo Update Notes (April 24, 2025)
notes.content:
[h1]⚡ BackStreet Update Notes (April 24, 2025)[/h1]

This update focuses on enhancing the intuitiveness and action-oriented nature of combat and interaction systems, as well as rebalancing early-stage difficulty and improving the item economy. Various improvements have been made to enhance overall stability and immersion.

---

[h3]🎮 Gameplay Balancing and Chapter Structure Adjustments[/h3]
- Boss HP and defense increased: HP 1000 → 1250 / Defense 0.5 → 0.6
- Early chapters (first 3 stages) have reduced difficulty.
- Increased frequency of crafting stages. Early elite monster spawns have been removed to smooth out the difficulty curve.
- Item and healing system adjustments
  - Healing pack values adjusted: 30 / 50 / 90 → 15 / 30 / 50
  - Skill prices significantly lowered (e.g., Multi Slash: 15 → 8, Straight Slash: 15 → 5)
  - Healing vending machines improved: Prevents reuse after crafting, adds visual/audio effects, and now only outputs small heal items.

---

[h3]🎨 UI & UX Improvements[/h3]
- Crafting material display added to Main HUD
- Fixed UI and currency icon errors at crafting stations
- Next-stage indication improved with +1 buffer to avoid confusion
- Camera control improvements
  - Smoother camera movement and character visibility handling
  - Improved camera response during skill usage; zoom/sensitivity fixes to come
- Combat and interaction system improvements
  - Trash bags can now be opened by attacking them

notes.title: BackStreet Demo Update Notes (March 17, 2025)
notes.content:
[h1]⚡ BackStreet Update Notes (March 17, 2025)[/h1]

[h3]🎮 Combat System Improvements[/h3]
- Slow Debuff Rework
  - Adjusted the Slow Debuff effect for better clarity.
  - Separated skill preparation & activation animations for BotTypeB / Elite / Boss enemies to improve timing.
  - Debuff Resist values now correctly apply to characters.
  - Slightly nerfed the Slow Debuff effect.

- Enemy Skill Improvements
  - Dash Attack and Jump Attack animations now connect more smoothly.
  - Energy Beam Attack now has a separate warning animation, giving players more time to react.
  - Fixed an issue where characters would spin incorrectly in certain skills.

- Booster Chip Balance Adjustments
  - Flame Booster Chip: Damage significantly increased (50x).
  - Oxidation Booster Chip: Damage increased (~10x).
  - Slow Debuff: Slight nerf (combo total debuff stat limited to 0.9).
  - Removed the player's default debuff stat.

---

[h3]🎨 UI/UX Improvements[/h3]
- Remaining Stages Display Added
  - Players can now easily check the number of remaining stages.
  - New animations added for stage completion and new stage start.

- Credits Screen Added
  - Credits button added to the main menu.
  - View developer information in the Credits Screen.
  - Added animations and camera transitions.

---

[h3]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where the Freeze Debuff was not applied.
- Fixed Slow Debuff issues.
  - Resolved cases where the effect did not apply correctly.
  - Fixed duplicate calculations of Debuff Resist values.
- Fixed Elite Monster scaling issue (Z scale adjusted 1.2 → 1.0).
- Fixed an issue where ESC/TAB menu could not be accessed after discarding Booster Chips.
- Improved Remaining Stages UI (added animations and better visibility).

---

This update includes combat system improvements, UI additions, balance adjustments, and various bug fixes.  
We will continue to enhance the game for a better experience! 🎮✨  

Thank you! 🚀
